testforge.title: TestForge — AI-Powered Test Case Generator
testforge.description: Writing test cases manually from 50-page requirement docs burns days of QA bandwidth. TestForge coordinates three autonomous AI agents (Reader, Architect, Formatter) to parse documents and generate production-ready Azure DevOps test suites with BDD Gherkin steps in under 3 minutes.
keyFeatures: Parses PDF, Word & Plain Text Docs

steps.code: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ..

githubreadmeforge.title: GitHub Readme Forge — AI Architecture & Doc Generator
githubreadmeforge.description: Brilliant open-source codebases often languish behind empty or stale READMEs. A three-agent AI pipeline scans your repository, extracts architecture diagrams and tech stacks, and forges a polished, narrative-driven README in 5 battle-tested styles across 6 languages.

steps.code: python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt

portforge.title: PortForge — AI-Powered Portfolio Builder
portforge.description: Built out of frustration with bloated, cookie-cutter website builders. Talk conversationally to an AI agent (Claude, Copilot, opencode) and get a production-ready React portfolio in minutes—featuring LinkedIn auto-import, 3 aesthetic styles (Minimal/Bold/Terminal), and one-click Vercel deployment.

instapostsforge.title: InstaPosts Forge — Autonomous AI Content Publisher
instapostsforge.description: Zero-server, set-and-forget social publishing. Autonomous AI agents evaluate photos directly from a Google Drive folder, write engaging, tone-aligned captions and hashtags via multi-LLM providers, and publish directly through Instagram Graph API on automated GitHub Actions cron schedules.
keyFeatures: Zero-Server Automated Publishing via GitHub Actions

steps.code: Add Google Drive credentials & Instagram access token in GitHub Secrets
Trigger via GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch or daily cron
